text: {"answer": "The on-disk KB store (`.tree-fs.json` + `.knowledge-base.yml`, plus ChromaDB and Neo4j) is owned by the Nuxt 3 Web UI, which reads those files directly on the hot search path via `kb-search-service.ts`. The browser never reaches FastAPI directly (no CORS): it issues fetch calls to the Nuxt 3 Web UI, which acts as a server-to-server proxy (with `trust_env=False`) forwarding to the FastAPI backend (dev 8765 / prod 8001).", "evidence_used": ["ARCHITECTURE"]}
